summary.text: Brad Jones is a Republican member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives for the 20th Middlesex District, first elected in 1994, and has served as House Republican Leader since 2002.
The Legislature's committee listing shows him as the ranking minority member of the Joint Committee on Telecommunications, Utilities and Energy.

paragraphs.text: Bradley H. Jones Jr.'s official biography says he is a North Reading native who graduated from North Reading High School in 1983 and worked in the school system as a tutor and substitute teacher.
It says he then attended The Johns Hopkins University and received associate's and bachelor's degrees from Harvard University Extension School in 1987 and 1988.
The biography lists his local service as the North Reading Housing Authority from 1988 to 1992 and the North Reading Board of Selectmen, which he chaired from 1995 to 1998.
It says he was elected to the House in 1994 and that his colleagues elected him House Republican Leader in 2002.
The biography also says he has never missed a roll call vote and has cast more than 5,000 consecutive roll call votes.

According to the biography, Jones has served on the Committees on Commerce and Labor, Housing and Urban Development, Federal Financial Assistance, Local Affairs and Ways and Means, and was the ranking member of the Committee on Election Laws.
It also says he served on the Special Commission to Study the Financing of the MBTA from 1995 to 1996 and lives in North Reading with his wife Linda and two children.
